agent_note: Multi-strand present-tense narration (Anna, Omeir, Zeno, Seymour, Konstance) with an embedded Aethon tale and a grandfather/backstory strand in past tense. 18 present / 7 past = 72.0% present, which lands in the 70-85% band METHODOLOGY flags as a known threshold gap - AUDIT REQUIRED. Only 3 of the 7 past quotes are strong (q05562 Aethon, q05595 and q05610 backstory); the other 4 (q05572, q05585, q05587, q05611) are tag-driven or aphorism-with-past-copula and are contestable. If those 4 went the other way the book reads 18/21 = 85.7% present, i.e. above the bar. The past minority is fully structural (embedded tale + recollection), matching the "Present + recollection strand" row. Very high gnomic rate (26/69) - this book is maximally adversarial for the Goodreads source.
